remarks: Welcome to 1689 Kensington Ave, a 3 bedroom, 1 bath Cape Cod located in the Cleveland Hill School District. Offering a flexible and functional layout, this home can live like a ranch with two bedrooms and the full bath conveniently located on the first floor. The main level also features a spacious living room, formal dining room, and eat-in kitchen with appliances included in the sale. Hardwood and LVP flooring can be found throughout the first floor. Off the back of the home, a sunroom/3-season room provides additional space to relax, entertain, or enjoy views of the backyard. Upstairs, you'll find a third bedroom along with a separate sitting room, providing flexible bonus space that could work well as a home office, reading area, dressing room, or additional living space. The full, dry poured-concrete basement offers plenty of storage and additional usable space, with the washer and dryer included in the sale. Several important updates have already been taken care of, including a new furnace in 2025, hot water tank in 2024, newer electrical panel, and a recently repointed chimney. The home also features a low-maintenance exterior and a mostly fenced backyard with room to enjoy the outdoors. Furniture can be included in the sale as well, offering added flexibility for the next owner. With first-floor bedroom and bathroom accommodations, additional space upstairs, a full basement, and a 3-season room, this home offers more versatility than you might expect from a traditional Cape Cod. Centrally located with convenient access to major thruways and nearby shopping, dining, and everyday amenities, 1689 Kensington Ave is ready for its next owner to make it their own.
